keywords: thank you stickers for small business

selling_points.en: Retro Daisy Artwork: A winking daisy holds a heart beneath bold thank you lettering. Cream, mustard, navy and burnt orange create a warm finishing touch for customer orders.
selling_points.zh: 复古雏菊图案：眨眼雏菊捧着爱心，搭配醒目的thank you字体；奶油白、芥末黄、海军蓝和焦橙色为客户订单增加温暖的致谢细节。

selling_points.en: Printed Vinyl Roll Labels: Thin printed vinyl, a self adhesive back and release liner make the labels easy to peel, position and press onto suitable clean, dry packaging surfaces.
selling_points.zh: 乙烯基卷装标签：薄型已印刷乙烯基面材、背胶和离型底纸构成揭贴结构，适用于合适且洁净干燥的包装表面。

selling_points.en: Small Business Packaging: Add a personal thank you to envelope flaps, gift bags, box seals and tissue wraps. The product supplied is the printed label, with packaging props shown for inspiration.
selling_points.zh: 小企业包装用途：用于信封翻盖、礼品袋、纸盒封口与薄纸包裹；供货实物为已印刷标签，包装道具仅展示应用方式。

selling_points.en: Custom Message and Colors: Personalize the daisy artwork, thank you wording, logo and palette. Round size examples are 25.4 mm, 38.1 mm and 50.8 mm diameter; custom sizes are available.
selling_points.zh: 图文与颜色定制：可调整雏菊图稿、感谢语、标识及配色；圆形尺寸示例为直径25.4、38.1及50.8毫米，并支持定制尺寸。

selling_points.en: Order by Label Count: Supply your artwork, size, total label quantity and roll packing requirements for a quote. MOQ from 500 pieces. Lead time from 5 days. Labels per roll are specified for each order.
selling_points.zh: 按标签张数订购：提供图稿、尺寸、总张数及卷装要求询价；最低500张起订，交期最少5天起，每卷张数按订单单独列明。

faq.q: What is included with this product?
faq.a: Custom printed self adhesive vinyl Thank You sticker labels on release liner rolls. The daisy, heart and lettering are printed artwork. Boxes, envelopes and other packaging props are not included.

faq.q: Can I change the daisy design or add my logo?
faq.a: Yes. Customize the daisy illustration, logo, message and colors. The example uses thank you and YOU MADE OUR DAY with a cream, mustard, navy and burnt orange palette. Send your preferred artwork and wording.

faq.q: Which label sizes are available?
faq.a: Common round examples are 25.4 mm, 38.1 mm and 50.8 mm diameter. Custom sizes and outlines are available. The size illustration is not to scale; use the stated dimensions when preparing artwork.

faq.q: How do I apply the stickers?
faq.a: Use a suitable clean, dry surface. Peel a printed label from the release liner, position it and press from the center toward the edges. Test a sample on your packaging material before bulk application.

faq.q: Where can these thank you labels be used?
faq.a: Use them on suitable envelope flaps, gift bags, box seals and tissue wraps for customer orders, handmade goods and gift packaging. Choose the size to match the available flat sealing area.

faq.q: How many stickers are supplied on each roll?
faq.a: Specify both the total label count and the preferred number of labels per roll. Roll core, winding direction and packing requirements are listed for the order. One label piece is different from one roll.

faq.q: What are the minimum order and production lead time?
faq.a: MOQ from 500 pieces. Lead time from 5 days. Send the finished label size, artwork, quantity and roll packing requirements to arrange your order.

faq.q: How can I get a quotation?
faq.a: Send the artwork, label size, total quantity, finish, roll packing and delivery destination. Request an itemized quote showing the printed labels, samples and shipping separately.

faq.q: What is included in the order?
faq.a: Custom printed paper self adhesive wine labels on a release liner. The illustrated supply format is rolls. Wine, bottles, glasses and other scene props are not included.

faq.q: Can I customize the brand name and illustration?
faq.a: Yes. Send your logo, wine name, illustration, vintage and preferred colors. GV, the amphora motif, 2025, 750 ML and 14% ALC/VOL are demonstration artwork; production uses your approved content.

faq.q: Which label sizes are available?
faq.a: Custom sizes are available. The size guide shows 76.2 x 101.6 mm and 76.2 x 127 mm, width x height, as common manufacturer examples. They are not fixed order sizes and the illustration is not to scale.

faq.q: How is the raised spot UV specified?
faq.a: Supply vector artwork with a separate layer identifying the raised UV areas. Select the paper and review a physical print sample to evaluate registration, gloss and relief on your design.

faq.q: Can I request paper and printing samples?
faq.a: Request paper swatches and a raised UV print sample to compare texture and touch. State your preferred paper, finished size, UV areas and delivery address; sample and courier charges are itemized.

faq.q: Can one order include several wine designs?
faq.a: Yes. List the finished dimensions and quantity for each design separately. Total pieces across a range and pieces per design are different quotation inputs; roll layout and any tooling are listed by configuration.

faq.q: What are the minimum order and lead time?
faq.a: MOQ from 500 label pieces. Lead time from 5 days. Request a production schedule for your artwork, number of designs, quantity and packing requirements. Roll count is calculated from the agreed labels per roll.

faq.q: How should I specify the bottle application?
faq.a: Send the bottle material and dimensions, application method and expected storage conditions, including refrigeration or ice bucket use. Test a sample on the actual bottle before bulk production and define the adhesive and paper specification in the order.

报价说明：Request an itemized quotation by finished label size, paper, adhesive, raised UV coverage, quantity per design, roll layout and destination. Samples, tooling and freight are listed separately.

Printed Wine Bottle Labels: Custom self adhesive paper labels present your winery name, cuvee and vintage on glass bottles. Labels are supplied separately; bottles and wine shown are application props.

Fine Laid Paper Texture: An ivory paper face with a fine linear texture provides a restrained background for dark lettering and detailed illustrations. Review paper swatches for the desired shade and hand feel.

Raised Spot UV Detail: Clear raised varnish highlights selected printed elements such as the wordmark and illustration. Separate UV artwork defines the relief areas while the surrounding paper retains its natural texture.

A Coordinated Wine Range: Customize the logo, illustration, color palette and vintage across several designs. The GV amphora and grape artwork, 2025, 750 ML and 14% ALC/VOL shown are demonstration content.

Printed Labels on Rolls: Specify finished size, quantity per design, UV coverage and roll layout for an itemized quotation. MOQ from 500 pieces. Lead time from 5 days; request a schedule for your artwork and order quantity.

What is included in the order?

Custom printed paper self adhesive wine labels on a release liner. The illustrated supply format is rolls. Wine, bottles, glasses and other scene props are not included.

Can I customize the brand name and illustration?

Yes. Send your logo, wine name, illustration, vintage and preferred colors. GV, the amphora motif, 2025, 750 ML and 14% ALC/VOL are demonstration artwork; production uses your approved content.

Which label sizes are available?

Custom sizes are available. The size guide shows 76.2 x 101.6 mm and 76.2 x 127 mm, width x height, as common manufacturer examples. They are not fixed order sizes and the illustration is not to scale.

How is the raised spot UV specified?

Supply vector artwork with a separate layer identifying the raised UV areas. Select the paper and review a physical print sample to evaluate registration, gloss and relief on your design.

Can I request paper and printing samples?

Request paper swatches and a raised UV print sample to compare texture and touch. State your preferred paper, finished size, UV areas and delivery address; sample and courier charges are itemized.

Can one order include several wine designs?

Yes. List the finished dimensions and quantity for each design separately. Total pieces across a range and pieces per design are different quotation inputs; roll layout and any tooling are listed by configuration.

What are the minimum order and lead time?

MOQ from 500 label pieces. Lead time from 5 days. Request a production schedule for your artwork, number of designs, quantity and packing requirements. Roll count is calculated from the agreed labels per roll.

How should I specify the bottle application?

Send the bottle material and dimensions, application method and expected storage conditions, including refrigeration or ice bucket use. Test a sample on the actual bottle before bulk production and define the adhesive and paper specification in the order.

faq.q: What is supplied with this product?
faq.a: Finished custom printed self adhesive vinyl labels on a release liner, supplied in rolls. Jars and honey in the images are application props.

faq.q: What material and finish are shown?
faq.a: The sample design uses a smooth glossy vinyl face with adhesive backing and a release liner. The graphics are color printed, with no foil or raised embossing in this configuration.

faq.q: Can I use my own logo and honey design?
faq.a: Yes. Send your logo, final product text and artwork in PDF or AI format with outlined fonts. LABELNEXOR, HONEY and FLORAL EDITION in the images are sample print content.

faq.q: Which size should I choose for my honey jar?
faq.a: Measure the usable width and height of your jar panel and allow space at seams and curves. The 152.4 x 50.8 mm and 177.8 x 63.5 mm examples are manufacturer market sizes, not measured dimensions of the pictured jar. Custom sizes are available.

faq.q: How are the labels applied?
faq.a: Use a clean dry jar surface. Peel the printed label from the release liner, align it on the jar and smooth from the center toward the edges. Evaluate a physical sample on your chosen container before bulk application.

faq.q: What roll details should I provide?
faq.a: Provide the finished label size, labels per design, preferred core diameter, roll diameter limit and unwind direction. Label quantity is counted in individual pieces; roll count depends on the agreed labels per roll.

faq.q: What are the MOQ and production lead time?
faq.a: MOQ starts from 500 label pieces and lead time starts from 5 days. The quotation states the schedule for the artwork, quantities and roll configuration in your order.

faq.q: How are samples and quantity prices quoted?
faq.a: Send the artwork, finished dimensions, quantity per design, roll requirements and delivery address. The quotation lists sample cost, unit price, production schedule and freight separately.

faq.q: What is supplied with this product?
faq.a: Continuous printed BOPP carton sealing tape wound on cardboard cores. Cartons and packing tools shown in the images are application props.

faq.q: Is this tape the same as individual fragile labels?
faq.a: No. This product is a continuous adhesive tape strip without die cut label gaps or a separate release liner. It is cut to the required application length.

faq.q: What material and adhesive are used for this configuration?
faq.a: The selected configuration uses BOPP film with acrylic pressure sensitive adhesive on one side and a glossy printed face.

faq.q: Can I print my own brand or warning message?
faq.a: Yes. Supply your artwork with the wording, brand name, simple icons and desired print colors. The illustrated designs are examples for customization.

faq.q: Which size information should I provide?
faq.a: State tape width in millimeters and full roll length in meters. The illustrated 48 mm x 66 m and 50 mm x 66 m options are market examples; custom sizes are available.

faq.q: How is the tape applied?
faq.a: Apply it across the seam of a closed carton on a clean dry surface, press the adhesive side onto the carton and cut the required length using suitable packing tools.

faq.q: Does the FRAGILE print replace protective packaging?
faq.a: No. It communicates a handling message. Select suitable cushioning, carton strength and packing methods for the contents and shipping route.

faq.q: How do I request pricing and a production schedule?
faq.a: Send tape width, roll length, core requirement, artwork, roll quantity and destination. Request an itemized quotation showing print setup, product cost, samples, freight and the production schedule.

Printed Fragile Packing Tape: Repeated FRAGILE and HANDLE WITH CARE messages make the handling instruction visible along a sealed carton. The product is printed tape supplied on rolls; boxes shown are application props.

BOPP Film with Acrylic Adhesive: A glossy film face carries the warning design, while a pressure sensitive adhesive coats one side. The tape unwinds as a continuous strip without a separate release liner.

Custom Repeat Artwork: Personalize the wording, brand name, simple icons and print colors for your packaging program. The red warning, navy Labelnexor and charcoal handling graphics shown are demonstration designs.

Carton Sealing Application: Align the printed strip over the closed carton seam, press it onto a clean dry surface and cut the required length. Choose compatible packing tools and evaluate adhesion on the actual carton.

What is supplied with this product?

Continuous printed BOPP carton sealing tape wound on cardboard cores. Cartons and packing tools shown in the images are application props.

Is this tape the same as individual fragile labels?

No. This product is a continuous adhesive tape strip without die cut label gaps or a separate release liner. It is cut to the required application length.

What material and adhesive are used for this configuration?

Can I print my own brand or warning message?

Which size information should I provide?

How is the tape applied?

Apply it across the seam of a closed carton on a clean dry surface, press the adhesive side onto the carton and cut the required length using suitable packing tools.

Does the FRAGILE print replace protective packaging?

No. It communicates a handling message. Select suitable cushioning, carton strength and packing methods for the contents and shipping route.

How do I request pricing and a production schedule?

Send tape width, roll length, core requirement, artwork, roll quantity and destination. Request an itemized quotation showing print setup, product cost, samples, freight and the production schedule.

faq.q: What is supplied?
faq.a: Finished custom printed self adhesive PET stickers with individual release liners. Gift boxes and other display props shown in the images are application examples and are not included.

faq.q: What creates the silver and rainbow appearance?
faq.a: The holographic PET face reflects silver tones and shifting rainbow highlights under different lighting and viewing angles. Black printed artwork provides contrast. The images are AI commercial visualisations.

faq.q: Which shapes are available?
faq.a: Round hexagonal and custom contour shapes can be specified. Send the intended outline together with the finished dimensions and artwork.

faq.q: Can I use my own logo and wording?
faq.a: Yes. Provide your approved logo text and artwork. LABELNEXOR PREMIUM 01 and custom are demonstration designs and will be replaced with the agreed production artwork.

faq.q: Are 50 mm and 75 mm fixed sizes?
faq.a: No. These circle diameters are illustrative size options. Select the finished dimensions from the actual usable area on your packaging. The size illustration is not a production drawing.

faq.q: How do I apply the stickers?
faq.a: Clean and dry a suitable smooth surface. Peel the printed sticker from its release liner align it to the intended position and press from the centre towards the edges. Assess fit and adhesion on the actual packaging material.

faq.q: What are the MOQ lead time and quantity unit?
faq.a: MOQ starts from 500 individual printed stickers and lead time starts from 5 days. State the quantity for each artwork and size. Pieces refer to stickers rather than rolls boxes or assorted sets.

faq.q: What information is required for a quotation?
faq.a: Provide the finished size shape artwork quantity per design packaging surface and packing requirements. Include the delivery destination for a separate freight quotation. Production pricing depends on the final specification.

selling_points.en: Clear and Opaque Options: Custom printed swimwear hygienic liners are available in clear vinyl and opaque kraft paper configurations. Choose the appearance for your bikini or underwear collection. Both options can be customised.

selling_points.en: Gusset Fitting Labels: Thin self adhesive liners fit the inner gusset area of swimwear bikini bottoms and underwear. The rounded waisted die cut shape carries your brand and retail try on instructions. Remove the liner after purchase.
selling_points.zh: 内裆试穿标签：薄型自粘浪底贴用于泳装、比基尼和内裤内裆区域，圆润收腰模切形状可印品牌与试穿提示，购买后移除。

selling_points.en: Your Print Design: Customise logos colours artwork and fitting instructions on either clear or opaque liners. The kraft burgundy rose sage and lavender designs shown are printed opaque samples with demonstration wording.
selling_points.zh: 两款均可定制图稿：透明和不透明款都可定制标志、颜色、图案及试穿说明；图片中的牛皮纸酒红、玫瑰粉、鼠尾草绿和淡紫设计为不透明印刷样例。

selling_points.en: Peel Position and Press: Separate a printed liner from its release backing align it with the garment gusset and press flat. Sheet and strip layouts keep labels organised for garment preparation packing and fitting room operations.
selling_points.zh: 揭取、对位与压贴：从离型底纸揭起已印标签，对齐服装内裆后压平；片装及条装便于制衣、包装备货与试衣准备。

selling_points.en: Custom Label Orders: Specify clear or opaque material dimensions shape print design and backing layout. MOQ starts from 500 individual labels and lead time starts from 5 days. Labels per sheet and packing quantities are stated separately.

faq.q: What are swimwear hygienic liners gusset stickers and wave bottom stickers?
faq.a: These terms refer to thin self adhesive fitting labels placed on the inner gusset of swimwear bikini bottoms or underwear. Swimwear hygienic liners and gusset stickers describe the product clearly. Wave bottom sticker is an additional listing keyword for the same use.

faq.q: Are clear and opaque versions both available for custom orders?

faq.q: What product is supplied?
faq.a: We supply finished printed self adhesive labels for supplement bottles and jars. Bottles, softgels and other props shown in the artwork are application examples and are not supplied with the labels.

faq.q: What material is shown in this image set?
faq.a: This product uses opaque white BOPP film with an adhesive backing and release liner. The printed white face supports the custom colors, logo and information layout for your supplement packaging.

faq.q: Can I customize the artwork and shape?
faq.a: Yes. Customize your logo, printed colors, text layout, label dimensions and die cut shape for the intended container. The Vitamin E design shown is a sample layout.

faq.q: Are the labels supplied in rolls?
faq.a: Yes, the illustrated white BOPP labels are supplied in rolls. State the number of individual labels, labels per roll, core size and winding direction in the order specification.

faq.q: Which label size should I choose?
faq.a: Use the available labeling area on your container. The 76.2 by 50.8 mm and 101.6 by 50.8 mm image examples illustrate possible rectangular layouts; custom sizes are available and the illustrations are not to scale.

faq.q: Can the label include a barcode and product information?
faq.a: Yes. Your artwork can include a barcode area and product information panels. Supply the final text and barcode data for your packaging project; the sample barcode in the images is illustrative.

faq.q: What are the minimum order and lead time?
faq.a: MOQ from 500 pieces and lead time from 5 days. Piece quantities refer to individual labels rather than rolls. The production schedule is listed with the order specification.

faq.q: What information is needed for a quotation?
faq.a: Send the label width and height, material, total label quantity, artwork, finish requirements and roll specifications. The quotation lists the production configuration and applicable charges separately.

faq.q: What product is supplied?
faq.a: We supply finished printed self adhesive label rolls for coffee flavor syrup bottles. The bottles, syrup, coffee beans and other scene props are application examples and are not included.

faq.q: What material and supply format are used?
faq.a: The label face is opaque white BOPP film with an adhesive backing and release liner. Finished labels are wound around a cardboard core for roll supply.

faq.q: How do gold foil and raised spot UV differ?
faq.a: Gold foil creates a thin metallic accent on selected artwork. Clear raised spot UV adds a low raised glossy coating to selected lettering. The illustrated tactile effect comes from UV buildup rather than mechanical embossing; the flower, beans and pods remain flat printed graphics.

faq.q: Can I customize the logo and artwork?
faq.a: Yes. Customize your logo, text, print colors, layout and die cut outline. Provide separate print, foil and raised UV areas in the artwork. The Labelnexor Vanilla artwork is an original sample design.

faq.q: Which label dimensions can I choose?
faq.a: Custom sizes are available for your bottle labeling area. The 50.8 by 76.2 mm and 76.2 by 101.6 mm image examples are market format examples, not measured bottle fits or fixed stock sizes. Illustrations are not to scale.

faq.q: What roll specifications should I provide?
faq.a: State the total number of individual labels, labels per roll, core diameter and winding direction. Core options include 3/4 in, 1 in and 3 in. These specifications are listed separately from the label size.

faq.q: What are the minimum order and lead time?
faq.a: MOQ from 500 pieces and lead time from 5 days. Pieces refer to individual labels rather than rolls. The order specification lists the production configuration and schedule.

faq.q: What information is needed for a quotation?
faq.a: Send the label width and height, total label quantity, white BOPP material requirement, artwork, foil and raised UV areas, and roll specifications. Production charges, freight and taxes are itemized separately.

Custom coffee syrup bottle labels combine your brand name, flavor artwork and packaging text in a coordinated design for cafe counters, retail displays and syrup gift sets.

Opaque white BOPP film carries the finished printed design on a self adhesive backing and release liner. Labels are supplied in rolls with a cardboard core.

What product is supplied?

We supply finished printed self adhesive label rolls for coffee flavor syrup bottles. The bottles, syrup, coffee beans and other scene props are application examples and are not included.

What material and supply format are used?

The label face is opaque white BOPP film with an adhesive backing and release liner. Finished labels are wound around a cardboard core for roll supply.

How do gold foil and raised spot UV differ?

Gold foil creates a thin metallic accent on selected artwork. Clear raised spot UV adds a low raised glossy coating to selected lettering. The illustrated tactile effect comes from UV buildup rather than mechanical embossing; the flower, beans and pods remain flat printed graphics.

Can I customize the logo and artwork?

Yes. Customize your logo, text, print colors, layout and die cut outline. Provide separate print, foil and raised UV areas in the artwork. The Labelnexor Vanilla artwork is an original sample design.

Which label dimensions can I choose?

Custom sizes are available for your bottle labeling area. The 50.8 by 76.2 mm and 76.2 by 101.6 mm image examples are market format examples, not measured bottle fits or fixed stock sizes. Illustrations are not to scale.

What roll specifications should I provide?

State the total number of individual labels, labels per roll, core diameter and winding direction. Core options include 3/4 in, 1 in and 3 in. These specifications are listed separately from the label size.

What are the minimum order and lead time?

MOQ from 500 pieces and lead time from 5 days. Pieces refer to individual labels rather than rolls. The order specification lists the production configuration and schedule.

What information is needed for a quotation?

Send the label width and height, total label quantity, white BOPP material requirement, artwork, foil and raised UV areas, and roll specifications. Production charges, freight and taxes are itemized separately.

selling_points.en: Vintage Washi Sticker Book: Printed floral, butterfly and nostalgic illustration designs provide coordinated materials for journals, planners, scrapbooks, cards and DIY collage projects.
selling_points.zh: 复古和纸贴纸书：花卉、蝴蝶及怀旧插画形成协调的拼贴素材，适用于手账、计划本、剪贴簿、贺卡及DIY拼贴。

selling_points.en: 24 Sheets per Book: The reference format contains 24 sticker sheets measuring 170 x 240 mm. Each sheet carries multiple printed motifs, giving buyers a clear book and sheet count for ordering.
selling_points.zh: 每本24张：参考规格包含24张170 × 240 mm贴纸内页，每页排布多个印刷图案，订购时可清楚区分本数、页数和单枚图案数量。

selling_points.en: Self Adhesive Washi Paper: Select a precut printed motif, lift it from the release backing and press it onto a clean, dry paper surface. Separate glue is not required for journal and scrapbook decoration.
selling_points.zh: 和纸不干胶：挑选预切图案，从离型底材揭取并贴于干净、干燥的纸面，无需另涂胶水即可完成手账与剪贴簿装饰。

selling_points.en: Four Coordinated Styles: Choose Like a Dream, Fleeting Years, Floral Splendor in the City or Splendid and Dazzling for different stationery assortments. Each style is a separate book option rather than four books per piece.
selling_points.zh: 四款主题选择：Like a Dream、Fleeting Years、Floral Splendor in the City及Splendid and Dazzling可用于不同文具组合；四款为选购款式，不表示每件包含四本。

selling_points.en: Custom Printing and Retail Packing: Supply your artwork for cover, illustration, color and size customization. The reference book uses a hanging hole OPP bag, with quotations prepared by book configuration, style mix and order quantity.
selling_points.zh: 定制印刷与零售包装：可提供图稿定制封面、插画、色彩和尺寸；参考款采用带挂孔OPP袋，按整本配置、款式配比及订购本数报价。

faq.q: What is supplied with one piece?
faq.a: One piece refers to one sticker book in a selected style. The reference book contains 24 sheets; individual sticker motifs are arranged on those sheets.

faq.q: What material is used for the stickers?
faq.a: The sticker face material is self adhesive washi paper supported by release backing. The cover and retail bag are separate components.

faq.q: What are the reference dimensions and sheet count?
faq.a: The reference sticker sheet size is 170 x 240 mm and the book contains 24 sheets. These are product reference specifications rather than shipping package dimensions.

faq.q: Are all four styles included in one piece?
faq.a: No. Like a Dream, Fleeting Years, Floral Splendor in the City and Splendid and Dazzling are separate style options. Specify the required number of books for each style when ordering.

faq.q: How do I use the stickers?
faq.a: Peel a precut printed motif from its release backing and press it onto a clean, dry journal, planner, scrapbook or card surface. No additional glue is required.

faq.q: Can the cover and printed artwork be customized?
faq.a: Yes. Provide your own artwork and specify the cover design, illustrations, colors, book size and required sheet count for a custom printing quotation.

faq.q: How is the reference book packed?
faq.a: The reference retail packaging is a hanging hole OPP bag. Include any outer carton, labeling and packing requirements with your inquiry.

faq.q: What information is needed for an accurate quotation?
faq.a: Send the number of books, style quantities, sheet size, sheets per book, artwork, packing requirements and delivery destination. Pricing is calculated per complete book rather than per individual sticker.

Vintage Washi Sticker Book: Printed floral, butterfly and nostalgic illustration designs provide coordinated materials for journals, planners, scrapbooks, cards and DIY collage projects.

24 Sheets per Book: The reference format contains 24 sticker sheets measuring 170 x 240 mm. Each sheet carries multiple printed motifs, giving buyers a clear book and sheet count for ordering.

Self Adhesive Washi Paper: Select a precut printed motif, lift it from the release backing and press it onto a clean, dry paper surface. Separate glue is not required for journal and scrapbook decoration.

Four Coordinated Styles: Choose Like a Dream, Fleeting Years, Floral Splendor in the City or Splendid and Dazzling for different stationery assortments. Each style is a separate book option rather than four books per piece.

Custom Printing and Retail Packing: Supply your artwork for cover, illustration, color and size customization. The reference book uses a hanging hole OPP bag, with quotations prepared by book configuration, style mix and order quantity.

What is supplied with one piece?

One piece refers to one sticker book in a selected style. The reference book contains 24 sheets; individual sticker motifs are arranged on those sheets.

What material is used for the stickers?

The sticker face material is self adhesive washi paper supported by release backing. The cover and retail bag are separate components.

What are the reference dimensions and sheet count?

The reference sticker sheet size is 170 x 240 mm and the book contains 24 sheets. These are product reference specifications rather than shipping package dimensions.

Are all four styles included in one piece?

No. Like a Dream, Fleeting Years, Floral Splendor in the City and Splendid and Dazzling are separate style options. Specify the required number of books for each style when ordering.

How do I use the stickers?

Peel a precut printed motif from its release backing and press it onto a clean, dry journal, planner, scrapbook or card surface. No additional glue is required.

Can the cover and printed artwork be customized?

Yes. Provide your own artwork and specify the cover design, illustrations, colors, book size and required sheet count for a custom printing quotation.

How is the reference book packed?

The reference retail packaging is a hanging hole OPP bag. Include any outer carton, labeling and packing requirements with your inquiry.

What information is needed for an accurate quotation?

Send the number of books, style quantities, sheet size, sheets per book, artwork, packing requirements and delivery destination. Pricing is calculated per complete book rather than per individual sticker.

selling_points.en: Custom printed round self adhesive labels are supplied on rolls for brand identification and packaging decoration on bottles, jars, paper bags, cartons, metal tins and outer packaging pouches.
selling_points.zh: 定制印刷圆形不干胶标签，卷装供货，可用于瓶、罐、纸袋、纸盒、金属罐及外包装袋的品牌识别与包装装饰。

selling_points.en: Choose coated paper, kraft paper, white BOPP, clear BOPP or holographic film. Each material is an alternative facestock with its own visible appearance, from paper texture to transparency or rainbow shine.
selling_points.zh: 可选择铜版纸、牛皮纸、白色BOPP、透明BOPP或全息膜；五种为独立可选面材，分别呈现纸纹、透明或彩虹光泽等外观。

selling_points.en: Customize the logo, wording, print colors and round label diameter. Finished printed samples show how bold yellow designs, neutral paper looks and clear or holographic options can support different packaging styles.
selling_points.zh: 支持定制Logo、文字、印刷配色与圆形标签直径；成品样例展示黄色醒目设计、纸感、透明和全息等包装风格。

selling_points.en: The thin printed label separates from its release liner for positioning and pressing onto a clean, dry exterior packaging surface. Specify the label count, core diameter and winding direction for your roll order.
selling_points.zh: 薄型印刷标签从离型底纸剥离后，可定位并按压于清洁干燥的包装外表面；订单可明确每卷数量、芯径及出标方向。

selling_points.en: MOQ from 500 pieces and lead time from 5 days. Send the label diameter, material, total quantity, application surface and artwork to receive an itemized quotation for your packaging project.
selling_points.zh: 最低500枚标签起订，交期5天起。提供标签直径、面材、总数量、被贴表面与图稿，可获得对应项目的分项报价。

faq.q: What is the product supplied?
faq.a: Finished custom printed round self adhesive labels on release liner rolls. Bottles, jars, cartons and other carriers in application images are display props.

faq.q: Which label materials are available?
faq.a: Coated paper, kraft paper, white BOPP, clear BOPP and holographic film are available as alternative facestocks. Choose the material for your artwork, package surface and desired appearance.

faq.q: Can I customize the printed design?
faq.a: Yes. The logo, text, print colors and round label diameter can be customized. Labelnexor artwork in the images is a demonstration design.

faq.q: Which label sizes are shown?
faq.a: The illustrated round diameters are 25.4 mm, 38.1 mm and 50.8 mm. These are manufacturer market examples, not measurements taken from the reference photo. Custom sizes are available.

faq.q: Which packaging surfaces can be shown with these labels?
faq.a: Application examples include paper cartons, paper bags, glass jars, plastic bottles, metal tins and outer packaging pouches. Select the adhesive construction for the actual surface and evaluate a sample before production use.

faq.q: How are the labels applied and supplied?
faq.a: Peel a printed label from its release liner, position it on a clean, dry packaging exterior and press it flat. Labels are supplied on rolls, with label count, core diameter and winding direction specified for the order.

faq.q: Is holographic film the same as an anti counterfeit label?
faq.a: Holographic film provides a rainbow appearance. This listing describes printed packaging labels and does not include a defined security authentication or tamper evident construction.

faq.q: What information is needed for a quote?
faq.a: Send the diameter, material, total label quantity, package surface and artwork, together with roll requirements. MOQ is from 500 pieces and lead time is from 5 days. Prices are quoted for the selected specification.

Custom Printed Round Label Sticker Rolls in BOPP Kraft Paper and Holographic Film for Bottles Jars Bags Boxes and Food Packaging

关键词：Custom round label rolls | Printed BOPP labels | Kraft paper roll stickers | Holographic packaging labels | Bottle jar and box labels

产品名称：Custom Printed Round Self Adhesive Roll Labels

供货形态：Finished printed labels on rolls

面材选项：Coated Paper / Kraft Paper / White BOPP / Clear BOPP / Holographic Film

结构：Printed facestock with adhesive backing and release liner

印刷：Custom logo text and color printing

形状：Round

尺寸示例：Diameter 25.4 mm / 38.1 mm / 50.8 mm

应用：Exterior labeling on cartons paper bags glass jars plastic bottles metal tins and packaging pouches

定制项目：Logo / Text / Color / Diameter / Material / Winding Direction

装卷要求：Label count core diameter and winding direction specified per order

起订量：MOQ from 500 pieces

交期：Lead time from 5 days

报价信息：Diameter material quantity application surface artwork and roll requirements

报价说明：Itemized quotation based on label diameter material artwork quantity and roll requirements.

Custom printed round self adhesive labels are supplied on rolls for brand identification and packaging decoration on bottles, jars, paper bags, cartons, metal tins and outer packaging pouches.

Choose coated paper, kraft paper, white BOPP, clear BOPP or holographic film. Each material is an alternative facestock with its own visible appearance, from paper texture to transparency or rainbow shine.

Customize the logo, wording, print colors and round label diameter. Finished printed samples show how bold yellow designs, neutral paper looks and clear or holographic options can support different packaging styles.

The thin printed label separates from its release liner for positioning and pressing onto a clean, dry exterior packaging surface. Specify the label count, core diameter and winding direction for your roll order.

MOQ from 500 pieces and lead time from 5 days. Send the label diameter, material, total quantity, application surface and artwork to receive an itemized quotation for your packaging project.

What is the product supplied?

Finished custom printed round self adhesive labels on release liner rolls. Bottles, jars, cartons and other carriers in application images are display props.

Which label materials are available?

Coated paper, kraft paper, white BOPP, clear BOPP and holographic film are available as alternative facestocks. Choose the material for your artwork, package surface and desired appearance.

Can I customize the printed design?

Yes. The logo, text, print colors and round label diameter can be customized. Labelnexor artwork in the images is a demonstration design.

Which label sizes are shown?

The illustrated round diameters are 25.4 mm, 38.1 mm and 50.8 mm. These are manufacturer market examples, not measurements taken from the reference photo. Custom sizes are available.

Which packaging surfaces can be shown with these labels?

Application examples include paper cartons, paper bags, glass jars, plastic bottles, metal tins and outer packaging pouches. Select the adhesive construction for the actual surface and evaluate a sample before production use.

How are the labels applied and supplied?

Peel a printed label from its release liner, position it on a clean, dry packaging exterior and press it flat. Labels are supplied on rolls, with label count, core diameter and winding direction specified for the order.

Is holographic film the same as an anti counterfeit label?

Holographic film provides a rainbow appearance. This listing describes printed packaging labels and does not include a defined security authentication or tamper evident construction.

What information is needed for a quote?

Send the diameter, material, total label quantity, package surface and artwork, together with roll requirements. MOQ is from 500 pieces and lead time is from 5 days. Prices are quoted for the selected specification.

main_image_plan.画面目标: 展示高端商业包装标签组合，让买家看清同一张吻切底纸上的圆形品牌标与长条封口贴，以及两种标签各自的贴法。
main_image_plan.画幅与构图: 1254 × 1254 正方形。贴纸张置于前景，保留完整四边，左列为三个圆标，右列为三个长条封口贴。
main_image_plan.产品展示: 左列为象牙白圆形 Logo 标。同纸色标记做浅压凸，下方保留黑色平面字标。右列为哑黑长条封口贴，字标和细线展示单色香槟金烫印。
main_image_plan.场景背景: 暖色石台。左上哑面香氛纸盒正面贴一枚完整圆标；右上哑黑礼盒用同款长条贴跨过盒盖接缝。
main_image_plan.功能展示: 右下长条贴轻揭一角，展示独立揭取与共用离型底纸。两处包装应用均展示贴纸紧贴包装表面的状态。
main_image_plan.细节放大: 浅压凸仅保留纸面细微高差和短边缘阴影。香槟金箔保持均匀单色及柔和金属光泽，去掉渐变和点状亮斑。
main_image_plan.英文文案: 仅在标签图案中保留 LABELNEXOR 字标，画面不加标题、角标或促销文字。
main_image_plan.B端表达: 以香水外盒正面品牌标和礼盒跨缝封口为主图示例。蜡烛外盒、化妆品纸盒和礼品袋可作为后续场景图，按包装贴附面核对适用性。
main_image_plan.色彩光线: 象牙白、哑黑和单色香槟金搭配暖色石材。柔和侧光显示纸张纹理、微浅压凸和金箔光泽。
main_image_plan.工艺说明: 压凸深度、面材、箔色、贴附效果及两类标签同张组合能力按实际打样确认。画面使用外包装示意。
main_image_plan.后续构图: 沿用已确认的黑金主图，分别展示圆标贴盒、长条贴跨缝及印后工艺近景。第6张主图为采购选项表。面材候选为哑面白纸、纹理象牙纸、哑黑纸；工艺展示平面印刷、浅压凸和单色烫金；最小起订量为100张成品贴纸。面材和工艺组合以打样确认为准。

Place your business logo and coordinated package seals on one sticker sheet to keep the same brand identity across different packaging pieces.

Peel individual kiss cut stickers from the shared release liner as needed at the packing station.

Use the logo stickers on box fronts and the matching seals on gift bag folds or paper wrapping.

Specify the size and shape of each design and the number of each sticker on the proposed sheet layout.

What is included on the business sticker sheet?

The planned configuration combines business logo stickers and coordinated package seals on a shared release liner.

Are the stickers supplied in sheets or rolls?

This listing is for kiss cut sticker sheets. The stickers are peeled individually from a sheet.

Can I include more than one design on a sheet?

Provide the artwork files and the quantity of each design per sheet for layout review.

What can the stickers be applied to?

The planned uses include external retail boxes, gift bags and paper wrapping. Provide the actual surface for selection.

How do I specify the size?

Provide the width and height of each sticker and the preferred outer sheet size in millimetres.

Can I use my own business logo?

Provide artwork that you own or are authorized to use, together with a reference for any required brand colours.

What is the quotation unit?

Request a quotation by finished sheet and specify the number of stickers and designs on each sheet.

What should I send for proofing?

Send the artwork, exact wording, cut outlines, colour reference and package surface before approving the layout.

The tubular film shrinks around the cap and neck, covering the joint between them with one continuous band.

The band fits over an already capped jug, so the printed seal can be added without changing the cap design.

A cap band sized to the actual neck profile lets bottlers choose how far the seal extends below the cap rim.

Wraparound printing makes a brand mark or opening instruction visible around the closure while leaving the jug body free for its main label.

An optional perforated tear line gives customers a defined place to start removing the sleeve before opening the jug.

Can you size the band from the jug capacity alone?

Send the cap and neck dimensions. Jugs of the same capacity can use different caps.

Which dimensions should I send?

Send the maximum cap diameter, the neck circumference and the desired finished band height.

Do you supply the cap or jug?

The quote covers the cap bands. The jug and cap are for application reference.

Can the band have a tear line?

Mark the desired location on the artwork and request a perforated trial.

What should I test on the line?

Check fit and appearance with your actual cap and shrink equipment and check opening if perforation is requested.

What artwork should I send?

Send a vector PDF or editable artwork with the target dimensions and mark any special finish or functional area.

Can I review a proof before bulk production?

Request a digital proof or physical sample and include the intended application when confirming the sample plan.

How do I get a quotation?

Send your target quantity and destination, plus these details: cap diameter neck circumference and finished band height. Pricing and lead time depend on the approved specification.

Model Number: ALI-TZ-001213

One adhesive strip spans the carton seam and carries its own tear lane, combining the closure and the opening feature in one component.

A projecting pull tab gives the recipient a place to grip without picking at the edge of the seal.

Parallel perforations guide the tear along the strip, giving the recipient an opening path that does not require running a blade along the box seam.

The kraft paper face blends with brown corrugated mailers, while a printed arrow stands out exactly where the box should be opened.

Custom strip length and tab position let the seal follow the closure of a shallow mailer or a longer parcel carton while keeping the tab within reach.

How do I choose the strip length?

Measure the seam and the bonding area and send a photo of the assembled carton.

Can I customize the pull indicator?

Mark the desired pull-end text or arrow and its direction on the artwork.

Can I use it on coated mailer boxes?

Send a sample or surface description. Bonding and opening should be tested on the actual carton.

Does the quotation include the box?

The quotation covers the closure strips. Provide a carton sample or drawing to review the design.

Does the strip provide tamper evidence?

The proposed construction is for opening. Any tamper-evidence claim requires a separate specification and test.

What artwork should I send?

Send a vector PDF or editable artwork with the target dimensions and mark any special finish or functional area.

Can I review a proof before bulk production?

Request a digital proof or physical sample and include the intended application when confirming the sample plan.

Send your target quantity and destination, plus these details: closure length bonding area and pull tab by carton. Pricing and lead time depend on the approved specification.

faq.q: What do I receive?
faq.a: Decorative washi tape in rolls. Specify the pattern and roll count for each design when ordering.

faq.q: Which designs are shown?
faq.a: The draft shows moon phases, scattered stars and celestial linework on dark paper. Identify your preferred roll by photo.

faq.q: Can I use my own constellation artwork?
faq.a: Send the repeating artwork with the intended metallic areas marked. We will review the smallest stars and lines at your requested tape width.

faq.q: Does every roll use both foil colors?
faq.a: The range shows gold and silver foil. Confirm the foil color and its placement for each design before ordering.

faq.q: How wide and long is each roll?
faq.a: The draft has no selected width or length. Include your target width in millimeters and length per roll in meters for confirmation.

faq.q: Can I use this on coated planner paper?
faq.a: Test the tape on the actual page stock to check adhesion and removal before using it across a full planner run.

faq.q: What is the minimum order and draft price?
faq.a: The current draft starts at 15 pieces at US$2.40 each, with US$1.98 each from 100 pieces. Confirm how many rolls are included per piece and request a separate quote for custom artwork.

faq.q: What lead time should I plan for?
faq.a: The draft specifies 15 days to dispatch for up to 100 pieces. For larger quantities or custom designs, confirm timing with the artwork and quantity per design.
